title: Childhood obesity and air pollution: Evidence from China
Impacts of the U.S. Safe Drinking Water Act Arsenic Rule on Arsenic Occurrence
abstract: This study provides the first retrospective analysis of the causal impacts of the 2001 US Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) Arsenic Rule on arsenic (As) occurrence in public drinking water systems. Using publicly available SDWA compliance data, we employ a difference-in-differences strategy that compares As concentrations before and after the promulgation of the rule for treatment relative to control water systems, defining treatment based on whether a water system had ever sampled As concentrations above the rule’s 10 μg per liter (μg/L) threshold before the Rule was published. We find that annual mean As concentrations in treatment systems fell by almost 5 μg/L (p < 0.01) after 2001 relative to control systems, representing a decrease of about 38% compared to pretreatment levels. In light of the Rule’s projected net costs at the time it was promulgated, assessment of the Rule’s realized impacts using actual measured As concentrations from a nationwide sample is an important first step in retrospective benefit–cost analysis.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次对2001年美国《安全饮用水法》（SDWA）砷规则对公共饮用水系统中砷含量的因果影响进行了回顾性分析。利用公开的SDWA合规数据，我们采用双重差分策略，比较处理组与对照组水系统在规则颁布前后的砷浓度，其中处理组的定义是：在规则发布前，该水系统是否曾检测到砷浓度超过规则规定的每升10微克（μg/L）阈值。我们发现，相对于对照系统，处理系统的年均砷浓度在2001年后下降了近5 μg/L（p < 0.01），较处理前水平下降约38%。鉴于该规则在颁布时预计的净成本，利用全国性样本中实际测得的砷浓度来评估该规则的实际影响，是回顾性效益—成本分析中重要的第一步。

Co-Benefits and Regulatory Impact Analysis: Theory and Evidence from Federal Air Quality Regulations
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy 2(1): 117-156
abstract: This paper considers the treatment of co-benefits in benefit-cost analysis of federal air quality regulations. Using a comprehensive data set on all major Clean Air Act rules issued by the Environmental Protection Agency over the period 1997-2019, we show that (1) co-benefits make up a significant share of the monetized benefits; (2) among the categories of co-benefits, those associated with reductions in fine particulate matter are the most significant; and (3) co-benefits have been pivotal to the quantified net benefit calculation in exactly half of cases. Motivated by these trends, we develop a simple conceptual framework that illustrates a critical point: co-benefits are simply a semantic category of benefits that should be included in benefit-cost analyses. We also address common concerns about whether the inclusion of co-benefits is problematic because of alternative regulatory approaches that may be more cost-effective and the possibility for double counting.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨联邦空气质量法规效益—成本分析中对协同效益的处理。利用1997—2019年间美国环境保护署（EPA）发布的所有主要《清洁空气法》规则的综合数据集，我们表明：（1）协同效益在货币化效益中占据相当大的份额；（2）在各类协同效益中，与细颗粒物（PM2.5）减排相关的效益最为重要；（3）在恰好一半的情形中，协同效益对量化的净效益计算起到了关键作用。基于这些趋势，我们构建了一个简单的概念框架，阐明了一个关键观点：协同效益本质上只是效益的一种语义类别，理应纳入效益—成本分析。我们还讨论了一些常见的担忧，包括纳入协同效益是否会因存在成本效益更高的替代监管方式而出现问题，以及是否存在重复计算的可能性。

Who Counts in Evaluating the Effects of Air Pollution Policies on Households? Non-Market Valuation in the Presence of Dependencies
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management 62(1): 65-79
abstract: Individuals who are likely to realize the largest benefits from improvements in air quality often depend on other members of their households to make time or monetary contributions to their care. The presence of these dependency relationships among household members poses challenges for benefit estimation since it is unlikely that the conditions necessary for recovering the underlying individual preferences from household choices are satisfied in this setting. We propose a conceptual framework that highlights the role of these dependencies in the choice models used to estimate the willingness to pay for environmental quality improvements. We design a complementary stated preference survey that describes hypothetical dependency relationships for household members of different ages to test the implications of our conceptual model. Respondents’ choices take into account the care-giving responsibilities for young children and teenagers but not for older adults.
abstract_zh: 最能从空气质量改善中获益的个体，往往依赖家庭中的其他成员，以时间或金钱投入来照顾他们。这些家庭成员之间的依赖关系，给效益估计带来了挑战，因为在此情境下，要从家庭选择中还原个体偏好所需的条件往往无法满足。我们提出了一个概念框架，突出这些依赖关系在用于估计环境质量改善支付意愿的选择模型中所起的作用。我们设计了一项辅助性的陈述偏好调查，描述不同年龄家庭成员之间的假设性依赖关系，以检验概念模型的含义。受访者的选择考虑了对幼童和青少年的照护责任，但没有考虑对老年人的照护责任。
